bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone — permit, visitor voucher or paid parking in marked bays (bay signs carry a two-letter code: zone letter + bay type, e.g. BR = Brixton resident bay)
bays.times: Zone hours are shown on the CPZ entry signs — Lambeth does not publish a per-zone hours table; single yellow lines in Lambeth are generally controlled 8.30am to 6pm, Monday to Saturday
bays.tariff: Emission-based on-street tariff — South Lambeth (Lambeth Council: CPZs L, G, M, H, O, R, I, U and SW): £4.66 per hour (band A) to £9.71 (band M), or £17.00 for a band M diesel, off-peak; peak £5.13 (band A) to £18.69 (band M diesel). Your vehicle's CO2 emissions band (A = lowest to M = highest) and fuel set the price; diesel pays a surcharge (included in the diesel figures). The first 15 minutes cost 25% of the hourly rate. Peak rate applies 10am to 1pm; off-peak at other controlled times. Full A–M band table on Lambeth's emission-based parking charges page
